name: Café Mali
kurzbeschreibung: Welcome to Café Mali in Tirol Discover the cozy charm of Café Mali in the heart of Tirol.
beschreibung: The Café Mali in the Außerfern region invites you to take a pleasant and restful break. This cozy café pampers its guests with a tempting selection of homemade cakes, strudels, and sweet delights. Accompanied by aromatic coffee specialties and refreshing drinks, the relaxed atmosphere and friendly service make it a favorite stop for locals and travelers alike. Whether stopping by after a hike or meeting with friends, Café Mali offers a heartwarming alpine welcome.
